title: How Grabbing the Job Nobody Wants Builds a Godly Man's Credibility
caption:
Nobody remembers the announcement. Everybody remembers who actually showed up.

Trust isn't built in the moments you're being watched. It's built in the job nobody assigned you and nobody thanked you for.

A godly man doesn't wait for a title before he moves. He sees what everyone's stepping around, and he takes it. Quietly. Without narrating it. Because the work is doing something in him that the credit never could.

Which job have you been stepping around?

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
